challenge.method: Compare flat, default smooth, and noperspective on a primitive with unequal linked vertex values. Inspect the adjacent patch prohibition and the flat plus centroid and sample cases.
challenge.results: Flat uses the same value supplied by whichever vertex the API identifies. No first or last vertex rule can be inferred from GLSL §4.5. Smooth and noperspective have distinct interpolation rules, and centroid or sample combined with flat retains the flat result.
